中文文本: 无法应用投影设置。请确认输入均为整数，选区未超出地图，分辨率为 128–4096 像素，刷新间隔为 1–60 帧。详细原因已写入日志。
英文文本: Could not apply these projection settings. Enter whole numbers, keep both areas within their maps, use a resolution of 128–4096 pixels and a refresh interval of 1–60 frames. See the log for details.

中文文本: 显示来源地图的全部内容。选择“框选区域”后，可以在缩略图上拖动选取范围。
英文文本: Shows the entire source map. Choose Select area, then drag a rectangle on the preview to crop it.

中文文本: 在缩略图上按住鼠标左键拖动，框选需要显示的区域。右键或 Esc 取消本次框选。
英文文本: Drag with the left mouse button to select the area to display. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the current selection.

中文文本: 纯显示只供观察。游玩模式可选择单位、建筑和物品，使用原版操作，并在窗口内缩放和平移。所有对象仍属于来源地图。
英文文本: Display only is for observation. Play mode supports selecting units, buildings and items, using native commands, and zooming and panning inside the viewport. All objects remain on the source map.

中文文本: 覆盖地形会将投影叠加在当前地图上。地形下方适合从空地或地形缺口观察来源地图；不透明地形会遮住投影。
英文文本: Above terrain draws the projection over the host map. Beneath terrain lets you view it through open space or terrain gaps; opaque terrain hides it.

中文文本: 在当前地图上按住左键拖出显示范围。放置后，拖动内部可移动，拖动四角可缩放；右键或 Esc 取消本次拖动。
英文文本: Drag on the host map to place the projection. Drag inside it to move it, or drag a corner to resize it. Right-click or press Esc to cancel the current drag.

中文文本: 没有符合条件的其他地图
左键选择对象，拖框多选；右键下达命令。滚轮缩放小地图，按住鼠标中键拖动平移；指针停在小地图内时，也可使用地图移动和缩放快捷键。点击外部地图或“返回当前地图”切回主地图。
英文文本: Left-click to select objects, drag to select a group, and right-click to issue orders. Use the wheel to zoom this viewport and drag with the middle mouse button to pan. Map movement and zoom keys also work while the pointer is inside. Click the host map or Return to host map to switch back.

中文文本: 此模式用于调整来源范围、窗口位置和尺寸。点击“完成并游玩”后，左键就会用于选择小地图中的对象。
英文文本: Use this mode to adjust the source area, window position and size. Choose Finish and play to select and interact with objects inside the viewport.

中文文本: 允许使用滚轮和地图缩放快捷键调整视角。关闭后保持当前缩放比例。
英文文本: Allow the mouse wheel and map zoom keys to change this viewport's zoom. Disable this to keep the current zoom level.

中文文本: 每个来源格占用一个宿主格，窗口尺寸由来源选区决定。启用后锁定视角缩放，并禁止拉伸。
英文文本: Each source cell occupies one host cell. The source area determines the window size. This setting locks zoom and prevents stretching.

中文文本: 左键选择对象，拖框多选；右键下达命令。此视口的配置已锁定缩放。按住鼠标中键可在来源范围内平移。点击外部地图或“返回当前地图”切回主地图。
英文文本: Left-click to select objects, drag to select a group, and right-click to issue orders. Zoom is locked by this viewport's configuration. Drag with the middle mouse button to pan within the available source area. Click the host map or Return to host map to switch back.

中文文本: 来源选区过大，无法按格子 1:1 放入宿主地图，请缩小来源选区。
英文文本: The source area is too large to fit in the host map at 1:1 cell size. Select a smaller source area.
